regions.today: Dry this evening with hazy spells of sunshine and light to moderate southwesterly winds.
regions.tonight: It will be dry tonight with clear spells. A few mist or fog patches will form in light south to southwesterly winds. Lowest temperatures will range from 7 to 12 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Mist and fog will clear in the morning and tomorrow will be a warm day with sunny spells. Highest temperatures of 19 to 23 degrees, with light southerly winds.
